brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a raid on the town of Beit Fajjar, located south of Bethlehem in the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The operation occurred as tensions remain high across Palestinian territories following months of military incursions and clashes.

The specific objectives of the raid and any resulting incidents were not detailed in initial reports. Beit Fajjar has experienced repeated Israeli military operations in recent months as part of broader security operations in the region. Residents of the town have faced frequent disruptions from such raids over an extended period.
